data.summary: The Google reviews appear authentic, presenting a mixed but credible picture of a contractor with quality work but significant customer service and communication failures, especially when problems occur. The severe Yelp rating discrepancy is a major red flag, but without Yelp review content, it's unclear if it reflects a separate pattern or platform bias. The owner's defensive and argumentative response to a critical Google review is concerning.
fake_signals: Extremely low Yelp rating with no visible reviews to analyze content
Owner's Google response admits to arguing with customer, suggesting unprofessional conduct that could deter honest reviews
Very low review volume (7 on Google, 5 on Yelp) for an established contractor increases susceptibility to manipulation
authentic_signals: Specific project details in Google reviews (re-plastering, tile, benches, leak testing)
Mixed reviews on Google include both detailed praise and detailed complaints, suggesting real customer experiences
Varied writing styles and specific names/dates in Google reviews
complaint_patterns: Substandard work quality (rough plaster, shotty tile)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Major discrepancy between Google (4.4) and Yelp (1.8) ratings. Google reviews are mixed but positive, while Yelp rating is very low, suggesting potential platform-specific issues or review manipulation.

reviews.text:
I highly recommend Richard Platz with Beyond Expectations. We had a 20 plus old pool re-plastered, new tile and two small sitting benches added last October 2022. Richard is reliable , very honest and communicated with me throughout the entire process and personally checked the project daily from start to finish.   He helped us decide on the right plaster product and color for the look we were trying to achieve.  He also went out of his way to check on the pool equipment and continues to help with any pool questions I may have after the project was completed.
We absolutely love how the pool turned out
reviews.author: Krysia Paluchowski

reviews.text: Richard Platz owner of Beyond Expectations, really went above and beyond with our pool repair! He was very careful in repairing and efficiently completed our job. We couldn’t have asked for a better, more professional company. We will definitely be calling Beyond Expectations out for any of our pool repair/remodeling needs in the future! We highly recommend this amazing pool company!
reviews.author: Amy Billingsley

reviews.text: I really wanted to like these guys. Bid was to to fix spa’s overflow plumbing and re-plaster the pool and install upgraded glass tiles. Project started great, project finished terribly. Once the pool/spa got refilled we noticed a leak in the spa. While we both agreed we can’t 100% say it was them, they agreed to leak test it and help me resolve (I was willing to pay). They then went several weeks with no communication, I had to follow up with them just to be informed that they changed their mind about resolving the issue. Furthermore, the Stonescapes (plaster) on the pool has many rough spots and shotty tile finish. They were going to come back and fix but they never called me back to schedule or resolve (it’s been 2.5 months since project finished). Conversations from ownership got very unprofessional at the end. Sad ending to what should have been a great experience. Bad call on ownership’s part. Now working with another local pool company to fix their errors.
reviews.author: Maxwell McNamara

reviews.text: Richard lives up to his name and consistently exceeds expectations! He was very hands-on and proactive through the whole process and we absolutely love our remodeled pool and backyard. Despite the labor and supply chain difficulties, Richard made it happen and kept us informed. Thank you Richard!
reviews.author: Dylana MacDonald

reviews.text: Don’t hesitate to contact Richard, his company is named appropriately. We needed mastic, mortar and coping repairs. The work is exceptional, professional and fairly priced.  He truly goes above and beyond.  We weren’t encouraged to do anything beyond the scope of our project. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Cynthia Minyard

reviews.text: We were referred to Richard by a friend.  So happy we listened.  The replastering of the pool looks amazing!!!!  Thank you.
reviews.author: Tina Gleisner
